goals.name: Git Basics in 5 Days
goals.description: Learn to track changes, branch and merge, then publish a small project. For beginners.

phases.name: First Commits
phases.description: What version control is for, and the everyday commands. About 2 hours.

phases.name: Branches and Sharing
phases.description: Branching, merging and putting work online. About 2 hours.

resources.title: About Version Control (Pro Git)
resources.notes: Know what problem version control solves and why Git is distributed.

resources.title: Recording Changes to the Repository (Pro Git)
resources.notes: Type each command as you read: status, add, diff and commit.

resources.title: Practice: a repository with ten small commits
resources.notes: Offline exercise. Write a clear message for each commit, then read them back with git log.

resources.title: Basic Branching and Merging (Pro Git)
resources.notes: Create a merge conflict on purpose and resolve it.

resources.title: Learn Git Branching
resources.notes: Free, interactive. Finish the introductory levels.

resources.title: Hello World (GitHub Docs)
resources.notes: Make a repository, a branch and a pull request of your own.
